title: Like a Butterfly
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Suiren Shibazeki is so admired for her looks that classmates treat her as unapproachable, and years of unwanted attention have left her nearly silent. At her new co-ed high school she is drawn to Taichi Kawasumi, a quiet karate champion who doesn't fawn over her. With help from her friends Aya and Yuri, the two slowly open up, become a couple and grow more expressive.
life_message: It holds up patient, honest love and friendships that help a shy person find her voice.

winners_losers: Patient, sincere people win; those who treat Suiren as a trophy fade out. Sympathy goes to quiet, honest affection.
